verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly confirm API-based, server-driven integration for building custom POS apps (docs-1, docs-18), plus SDKs, built-in test simulator (docs-9), reader registration/fleet management, offline payment storage, and receipts/tipping customization for a fully custom checkout flow. Community evidence from a real integrator corroborates deep API-level terminal integration combined with Connect. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of the server-driven (non-SDK) API path specifically, and a public OpenAPI spec confirmation (probe found 404s on openapi.json paths).
